cases.name: progress for manager
cases.expected:
[fleet] Progress update from a worker — it is STILL RUNNING; this is NOT a completion:
- Worker (session:worker-1, cwd /project) — NEEDS A DECISION — reports: phase landed
The worker sent this ITSELF, mid-task, and is still running: its finish wake will still arrive. Do NOT record it in a brief's "## Recently" as work landed, and do not treat its line as a result. If it needs no decision, do NOTHING — a bare acknowledgement costs the worker a turn and tells it nothing. If it flags NEEDS A DECISION, or if the update shows the dispatch going wrong, answer it with send_message, or stop it (signal SIGTERM, then close_session) and redispatch surgically with respawn_with. Then STOP again — do not start polling, and do not ask it for further updates.
